name: Bad Language
overview: Scripture commands believers to guard their speech carefully, forbidding the misuse of God's name and any corrupt or filthy communication. The Word calls for speech that builds up others with grace rather than foolish or inappropriate talk, emphasizing the need to put away anger, malice, and blasphemy from our mouths. Those who promote harmful teachings through corrupt speech are to be silenced, underscoring the seriousness of using language that honors God and edifies the church.
